description: This file defines the Dashboard class within the Opencart Admin Controller's Common namespace. It provides methods for displaying the admin dashboard, including loading language resources, setting up breadcrumbs, retrieving dashboard extensions, organizing layout columns, and rendering the dashboard view.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Handles the display and layout organization of the admin dashboard page in OpenCart, including loading language files, setting breadcrumbs, managing extensions, and rendering the dashboard view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate the dashboard page, set up layout components, load extensions, and output the rendered view.
